说明: 专八晴空校园第 2 批（t04—t07）截图盲审意见原文（埋雷 5/5 全部查出）；第 1、3 批因用量周限额中断未审。用户 2026-10-20 要求先做考研，这些意见待专八恢复时处理。

findings.what: The vocabulary card is far too large: its text is about 1.5× normal and the card runs past both the top and bottom of the frame. Entries 1–2 are cut off at the top (only a fragment of '打捞' shows). Entry 7's gloss 'fervor for 对……的狂热；……热' and entries 8–9 (Arctic, exploration) are cut off at the bottom. The card also covers the header title ('2024年…打捞'). The 'aboard' gloss is broken into stray lines: '在' / '（船、飞机等）' / '上'.

On the cover, the title runs past the white card and off the right edge of the frame. '北极沉船“调查者”' fills the line and the rest of the title is cut off, so the closing ” is clipped at the edge. The huge glyphs also sit on top of the sun and cloud art.
Garbled Chinese: the translation reads '在水▯以下25英尺处' with a missing-glyph box where '面' should be. The reference has '在水面以下'.

The English and Chinese are far larger than on comparable screens, roughly 1.6×. The English wraps to one or two words per line ('design³' and '26 countries.' each sit alone), and the Chinese block almost touches the bottom edge of the card. The vocab card next to it is normal size.
The first English line is wrongly indented. 'The Greens¹, led²' starts about halfway across the card, leaving a large blank gap on the left, while the following lines start at the normal margin.

Letter-spacing defect at the start of the sentence: 'W hen' shows a visible gap between W and h. The same gap appears in t04 screen06 ('W hoa') and t06 screen52 ('W hy'), so it looks systemic for a capital W followed by h.
Visible gap inside the word: 'W hoa' (and 'W hoa' in the vocab entry), the same W+h spacing defect as t06 screen52 and t07 screen07.
Visible gap between W and h at the start of the sentence, so it reads 'W hy we stuck to…'.
The first Chinese line breaks right after '两位科学家', leaving about half the line blank, because the long parenthetical '（卢埃拉·凯洛格和温思罗普·凯洛格）' is kept unbroken on the next line. Same problem on screen11.
Same awkward Chinese wrap as screen10: line 1 ends early at '两位科学家' with a large empty space before the parenthetical name block.
The Chinese breaks inside a short parenthetical: line 2 ends with '（指' and line 3 starts with '天鹅）；'.
The Chinese line break separates a word from its gloss: '“papa”' ends one line and '（爸爸）' starts the next.
The Chinese splits a word across lines inside the parenthetical: '（北极西部的因纽' / '特人）'.
In vocab entry 10 (pullethood), the English word 'pullet' sits alone on its own line in the middle of the gloss ('…造的词；' / 'pullet' / '指未满一岁的小母鸡）').
In the English, 'Mr.' sits alone at the end of line 3, separated from 'Albert Griggs' on the next line. A non-breaking space is needed after 'Mr.'.
The Chinese splits a numeral from its noun across lines: '…后部放着一' / '板条箱活鸡，'.
An English line ends with the lone pronoun 'I' ('…of his head was, I' / 'fancied⁷, …'), which reads awkwardly.
Vocab glosses wrap at bad points. Entry 3 breaks the phrase as '没有走到……' / '的地步；（几乎要做某事但）' / '终究没有做'. Entry 2 splits '（Member of Parliament' / '的缩写）'.
